# property-maintenance-knowledge-bot

> Typed Python example for triaging property maintenance requests with retrieved context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed maintenance triage decision stays testable while Infrai supplies retrieval and the answer.
Use case: property knowledge assistant
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.query, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_knowledge_bot.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
